description: Source code for a shell command execution tool with security, approval, and environment management features, including functions for running commands, validation, and handling approvals.

methods.name: buildExecForegroundResult
methods.description: Constructs an AgentToolResult based on the outcome of executing a process, including handling failures and success with output.

methods.name: isShellEnvAssignmentToken
methods.description: Checks if a token is a shell environment variable assignment.

methods.name: isEnvExecutableToken
methods.description: Determines if a token is an 'env' executable, considering Windows '.exe' suffix.

methods.name: stripPreflightEnvPrefix
methods.description: Removes preflight environment variable assignments and env command wrappers from command arguments.

methods.name: extractScriptTargetFromCommand
methods.description: Analyzes a command string to identify if it targets a Python or Node script, returning its type and paths.

methods.name: extractUnquotedShellText
methods.description: Extracts raw shell command text outside of quotes, handling escape sequences.

methods.name: analyzeInterpreterHeuristicsFromUnquoted
methods.description: Detects presence of Python, Node, complex syntax, process substitution, and script hints in unquoted shell command text.

methods.name: extractShellWrappedCommandPayload
methods.description: Extracts command payload from shell wrapper commands like bash, sh, zsh, etc.

methods.name: shouldFailClosedInterpreterPreflight
methods.description: Determines if a command's interpreter invocation is complex or ambiguous, requiring preflight validation.

methods.name: parseExecApprovalShellCommand
methods.description: Parses /approve shell commands to extract approval ID and decision.

methods.name: rejectExecApprovalShellCommand
methods.description: Rejects execution of /approve commands and commands with complex or unsafe shell invocations.

methods.name: deriveExecShortName
methods.description: Generates a short name for an executable path, removing extensions like .exe.

methods.name: describeExecTool
methods.description: Provides a description string for the exec tool, including platform-specific notes and allowlist info.

methods.name: createExecTool
methods.description: Factory function that creates an AgentTool for executing shell commands with security, approval, environment, and runtime management.
